def solve_batch(study: dict) -> dict:
    from scipy.optimize import least_squares
    train = study['train']
    n = len(train['x'])
    z = _calibrate(study['panel_a'], np.vstack((train['x'], study['test']['x'])))
    c = _branch(study['panel_c'], z, 'v1', 'soft')
    d = _branch(study['panel_c'], z, 'v2', 'cyclic')
    f = _design(z, c, d)
    t = np.asarray(study['eval_times'])
    traj = np.asarray(train['traj'])

    def residual(p):
        q = _time(t, p)
        return (traj.T - q @ np.linalg.lstsq(q, traj.T, rcond=None)[0]).ravel()
    rates = least_squares(residual, np.log([0.4, 1.8]), bounds=(np.log([0.12, 1.0]), np.log([0.9, 4.0]))).x
    q = _time(t, rates)
    a = np.linalg.lstsq(q, traj.T, rcond=None)[0].T
    pred = f[n:] @ np.linalg.lstsq(f[:n], np.column_stack((train['y'], a)), rcond=1e-09)[0]
    (yh, state) = (pred[:, 0], pred[:, 1:] @ q.T)
    last = state[:, -1]
    return dict(y_hat=yh, state_pred=state, diagnostics_vec=np.array([yh.mean(), yh.std(), last.mean(), last.std()]))

def _panel_pred(study, blend, reg, kind):
    tr = study['train']
    n = len(tr['x'])
    xx = np.vstack([tr['x'], study['test']['x']])
    p = study['panel_a']
    u = np.asarray(p['u'])
    v = np.asarray(p['v'])
    h = np.column_stack([np.ones(len(u)), u])
    av = np.linalg.lstsq(h, v, rcond=None)[0]
    r = np.linalg.norm(v - h @ av, axis=1)
    keep = r < 3
    gains = []
    offsets = []
    for j in range(4):
        c = np.linalg.lstsq(h[keep][:, [0, j + 1]], v[keep, j], rcond=None)[0]
        offsets.append(c[0])
        gains.append(c[1])
    z = (xx - offsets) / gains
    if kind == 'sat':
        p = study['panel_c']
        u = np.asarray(p['u'])
        v = np.asarray(p['v2'])
        h = np.column_stack([np.ones(len(u)), u])
        b = np.linalg.lstsq(h, v, rcond=None)[0]
        pz = np.column_stack([np.ones(len(u)), u, np.expm1(-0.2962 * u * u)])
        w = np.linalg.lstsq(pz, v, rcond=None)[0]
        v = np.column_stack([np.ones(len(z)), z, np.expm1(-0.2962 * z * z)]) @ w
        z = z + blend * ((v - np.column_stack([np.ones(len(z)), z]) @ b) @ np.linalg.inv(b[1:]))
        t = np.tanh(z)
    else:
        z = z + blend * np.expm1(-0.2962 * z * z)
        t = None

    def quad(a):
        return [a] + [a[:, i] * a[:, j] for i in range(4) for j in range(i, 4)]
    f = np.column_stack(quad(z) + (quad(t) if t is not None else [np.sin(z), np.cos(z), np.sin(2 * z), np.cos(2 * z)]))
    f = (f - f[:n].mean(0)) / np.maximum(f[:n].std(0), 1e-07)
    y = np.column_stack([tr['y'], tr['traj']])
    ym = y.mean(0)
    return f[n:] @ f[:n].T @ np.linalg.solve(f[:n] @ f[:n].T + reg * np.eye(n), y - ym) + ym
